findings.evidence: The same rewrite sequence appears in all four proofs; Mathlib's Submodule/Map.lean has only `map_equiv_eq_comap_symm` (line 566), not this iff.
findings.fix: Add one general lemma, e.g. `Submodule.map_equiv_eq_iff (e : M ≃ₗ[R] M₂) : N.map e = N' ↔ ∀ x, e x ∈ N' ↔ x ∈ N`, and derive all four uses from it.
findings.issue: The proof that `N.map e = N'` iff `∀ x, e x ∈ N' ↔ x ∈ N` is written inline here and again in `localLinearEquivOfMapsRange` (`hmap`, Basic.lean), `exists_adelicTranslate_eq` (`hmap`, DoubleCoset.lean) and the final rewrite chain of `sameGenus_adelicTranslate`. Each copy is a brittle chain of `mem_map_equiv`/`restrictScalars_symm_apply`/`apply_symm_apply`/`coe_toLinearEquiv` rewrites.

findings.evidence: `let γ : orthogonalGroup L.norm := ⟨e, L.orthogonalGroup_norm ▸ LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_isometryGroup_iff.mpr fun x y ↦ e.toIsometryEquiv.map_app y x⟩` and `⟨φ.toLinearEquiv, L.orthogonalGroup_norm_baseChange p ▸ LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_isometryGroup_iff.mpr fun x y ↦ ...⟩`.
findings.fix: Use `(isometryGroupEquivIsometryEquiv _).symm` (already used in `sameGenus_adelicTranslate`), transported along `orthogonalGroup_norm`/`orthogonalGroup_norm_baseChange`, or factor out a helper that does this.
findings.issue: `exists_adelicTranslate_eq` and `doubleCosetClass_injective` both build an orthogonal-group element from an isometry equivalence by hand via `orthogonalGroup_norm(_baseChange) ▸ mem_isometryGroup_iff.mpr fun x y ↦ (... map_app y x)`.

findings.evidence: The ascription occurs in `adelicTranslateCarrier`, `isLattice_and_padicLocalization_adelicTranslateCarrier` (three times), `mem_adelicTranslate_carrier_iff`, `padicLocalization_adelicTranslate_carrier`, `exists_adelicTranslate_eq` and `mem_localStabilizer_iff_map_eq`.
findings.fix: Introduce a named local translate (e.g. `L.localTranslate p k := (L.carrier.padicLocalization p).map ...`) with its membership simp lemma, and state `mem_localStabilizer_iff_map_eq`, `padicLocalization_adelicTranslate_carrier` and `exists_adelicTranslate_eq` in terms of it.
findings.issue: The ascription `((g p : ℚ_[p] ⊗[ℚ] V ≃ₗ[ℚ_[p]] ℚ_[p] ⊗[ℚ] V).restrictScalars ℤ_[p]).toLinearMap` applied to `L.carrier.padicLocalization p` appears in about eight statements and proofs, so their shared structure is hard to see.

summary: One reusable fact (an equivalence maps N onto N' iff it preserves membership pointwise) is proved inline by rewrite chains in four places, and the construction of an orthogonal-group element from an isometry equivalence is repeated by hand. The rest of the proofs read cleanly.
